sectors.label: Entertainment
sectors.definition: Narrative-first content meant to amuse, engage, or emotionally hook. Includes skits, dramas, pop culture, celebrity content.

children.label: Movies & TV
children.definition: Narrative content about scripted entertainment — includes reviews, recaps, breakdowns, and lore analysis.

children.label: Film
children.definition: Films and filmmaking from the audience side: critique, analysis, and discussion of story, craft, and cultural impact.
children.scope_note: Excludes television series (01.01.002) and nature or space storytelling (13.41.083).

children.label: Blockbuster Films
children.definition: Covers major studio films, franchises, and tentpole releases, including their story, spectacle, and cultural impact.

children.label: Independent Film
children.definition: Covers independent and arthouse cinema, including its narrative themes and artistic style.

children.label: Television
children.definition: Scripted television series: episodes, arcs, characters, and the conversation around them.
children.scope_note: Excludes film (01.01.001).

children.label: Currently Airing Series
children.definition: Covers scripted series during their broadcast run, followed episode by episode as new installments release.

children.label: Season Arcs & Finales
children.definition: Highlights seasonal arcs or finales with emphasis on narrative payoff or fan impact.

children.label: Comedy
children.definition: Humor-forward content designed to entertain through skits, satire, parody, improv, or stand-up.

children.label: Sketch & Improv Comedy
children.definition: Scripted sketches and improvised scenes performed for laughs.
children.scope_note: Excludes pretend play made for kids (01.67.161). Parody of a specific genre keeps that genre's path with Format 67 Parody.

children.label: Scripted Sketches
children.definition: Covers scripted comedy sketches written and performed as self-contained scenes.

children.label: Improv Scenes
children.definition: Improvised comedy content featuring spontaneous dialogue and unpredictable scenarios.

children.label: Stand-Up
children.definition: Solo comedic performances delivered to a live or virtual audience, often observational or narrative in tone.

children.label: Club & Open Mic Sets
children.definition: Covers stand-up sets performed at comedy clubs, open mics, and touring shows outside of produced specials.

children.label: Comedy Specials
children.definition: Long-form recorded comedy specials with structured pacing and audience engagement.

children.label: Music & Performance
children.definition: Live or recorded expression through music, dance, acting, or talent-based performance.

children.label: Music Releases
children.definition: Recorded music and its visual releases: singles, music videos, and independent audio-visual work.
children.scope_note: Excludes how music is written or produced (06.18) and live concerts (01.03.006).

children.label: Pop Releases
children.definition: Showcases professionally released music content for mainstream distribution.

children.label: Indie & Experimental Music
children.definition: Highlights independently produced music videos or audio-visual experiments.

children.label: Concerts & Stage Performance
children.definition: Music, theater, dance, or busking performed before an audience, at venues or in public spaces.
children.scope_note: Excludes kids' songs (01.67.159) and worship services (16.51.113).

children.label: Concerts & Festivals
children.definition: Covers concerts, music festivals, and ticketed live music events.

children.label: Street Shows
children.definition: Street-level performances including dance, theater, or busking recorded in public spaces.

children.label: Kids & Family
children.definition: Genres made for children that have no adult equivalent: kids' songs, toy play, and kids' animation.
children.scope_note: Excludes children's versions of other subjects, such as early learning (02.04.160), science, gaming, and crafts, which take that subject's path with made_for_kids = TRUE, and family vlogs made for adults (10.29.059).

children.label: Nursery Rhymes & Kids' Songs
children.definition: Songs, rhymes, and music made for young children, usually animated or performed for sing-along.

children.label: Nursery Rhymes & Sing-Alongs
children.definition: Classic and original nursery rhymes and sing-along songs.

children.label: Dance & Movement Songs
children.definition: Songs built around dancing, actions, and movement for kids.

children.label: Toy Play & Unboxing
children.definition: Toys opened, played with, and used to tell stories, made for a child audience.

children.label: New Toys & Collectibles
children.definition: Covers newly released toys, playsets, and surprise collectibles presented for a child audience.

children.label: Pretend Play & Toy Stories
children.definition: Stories acted out with toys, dolls, and playsets.

children.label: Kids' Animation & Characters
children.definition: Animated series, recurring characters, and story content made for children.

children.label: Animated Kids' Series
children.definition: Episodic animated shows and character channels for children.

children.label: Picture Books & Bedtime Stories
children.definition: Covers picture books, fairy tales, and bedtime stories for young children.

children.label: Competitions & Spectacle
children.definition: Large-scale creator competitions, stunts, and giveaway spectacles built around stakes and elimination.
children.scope_note: Use when the competition or stunt itself is the subject. A challenge about another topic (cooking, fitness) keeps that topic's path, with Format 07 Challenge where that Sub-Niche lists it (Rule 6.10).

children.label: Creator Competitions
children.definition: Contests among participants for a prize: last-to-leave games, elimination games, and team challenges.

children.label: Elimination Games
children.definition: Participants are knocked out round by round until one wins the prize.

children.label: Endurance Contests
children.definition: Last-to-leave and how-long-can-you-last contests where the prize goes to whoever holds out.

children.label: Stunts & Giveaways
children.definition: Large-budget stunts, builds, and giveaways staged for spectacle.

children.label: Extreme Stunts
children.definition: Dangerous, extreme, or record-setting stunts and builds performed for an audience.

children.label: Giveaway & Philanthropy Spectacles
children.definition: Large giveaways and staged acts of generosity built as entertainment.

sectors.label: Education
sectors.definition: Purpose is to teach, explain, or transfer skills. Includes tutorials, explainers, language learning, academic breakdowns.
sectors.scope_note: Excludes nursery rhymes and kids' songs (01.67.159). Early learning for young children stays here (02.04.160) with made_for_kids = TRUE.

children.label: Academic
children.definition: Formal subject matter rooted in school or university disciplines — often structured and instructional.

children.label: Math Lessons
children.definition: Teaches math concepts or problem-solving using clear, step-by-step visual instruction.

children.label: Algebra
children.definition: Covers algebraic concepts and problem-solving, from equations and variables to functions.

children.label: Calculus
children.definition: Covers calculus principles such as limits, derivatives, and integrals.

children.label: History Lessons
children.definition: Explains historical events, timelines, figures, or cultural eras through narrative or analysis.
children.scope_note: Excludes military history (05.15.104) and historical conspiracies (05.15.091).

children.label: Ancient Civilizations
children.definition: Presents historical timelines, leaders, and civilizations through artifacts and analysis.

children.label: Modern History
children.definition: Covers twentieth- and twenty-first-century history and its impact on contemporary society.

children.label: Preschool Learning
children.definition: Early-learning content teaching letters, numbers, colors, shapes, and first words.

children.label: ABCs & Counting
children.definition: Alphabet, phonics, and counting lessons for preschoolers.

children.label: Colors, Shapes & First Words
children.definition: Early vocabulary, colors, and shapes taught through repetition and play.

children.label: Skills & DIY
children.definition: Instructional content teaching practical, hands-on tasks like repairs, crafts, or creative builds.

children.label: Coding & Programming
children.definition: Learning to code: building, testing, and deploying software, taught step by step.
children.scope_note: Education when the primary intent is teaching a learner step by step. Excludes content about the technology itself for practitioners: demos, debugging, best practices (04.11).

children.label: Web Development
children.definition: Teaches how to build websites through HTML, CSS, and JavaScript foundations.

children.label: App Coding
children.definition: Demonstrates mobile or cross-platform app creation from design to deployment.

children.label: Handcrafts
children.definition: Making objects and handmade goods by hand, taught step by step, such as woodworking and sewing.
children.scope_note: Step-by-step instruction for learners. Excludes the maker's process, finished work, and craft culture (06.45).

children.label: Woodworking
children.definition: Walks through hands-on woodworking projects from materials to finishing techniques.

children.label: Sewing
children.definition: Covers sewing construction, stitching techniques, and fabric selection for garments and household items.

children.label: Science & Discovery
children.definition: Content exploring physical, natural, or theoretical phenomena with curiosity and explanation.
children.scope_note: Classroom-style science teaching for learners. Excludes research, discoveries, and science news (Sector 13).

children.label: Space Exploration
children.definition: Explores human and robotic exploration of space, astronomy, or rocketry.

children.label: Planets & Moons
children.definition: Covers the planets, moons, and other bodies of the solar system and beyond.

children.label: Space Missions
children.definition: Covers technical details of crewed and robotic space missions, launches, and landings.

children.label: Nature Studies
children.definition: Educational content on ecosystems, wildlife, and earth’s natural environments.

children.label: Wildlife Behavior
children.definition: Analyzes animal behavior, instincts, and interactions in their natural environments.

children.label: Ecosystems & Habitats
children.definition: Covers ecosystems and habitats, including their species, terrain, climate, and environmental balance.

children.label: Language Learning
children.definition: Learning, teaching, and living in other languages, from structured lessons to immersion and culture.

children.label: Language Lessons
children.definition: Structured instruction in a language, from first words to grammar and vocabulary.

children.label: Essential Phrases
children.definition: Covers greetings, introductions, and everyday core phrases for new learners.

children.label: Grammar & Vocabulary
children.definition: Targeted lessons on grammar rules, word lists, and common mistakes.

children.label: Language Learning Journeys
children.definition: Documenting the process of learning a language, including challenges, progress, and immersion.

children.label: Self-Taught Learning
children.definition: Covers learners teaching themselves a language on a set timeline, from first lessons to fluency milestones.

children.label: Immersion & Polyglot Life
children.definition: Living in or switching between languages, often with native-speaker conversations.

children.label: Language & Culture
children.definition: Slang, idioms, accents, and the cultural context behind how a language is spoken.

children.label: Slang & Idioms
children.definition: Everyday expressions, slang, and idioms native speakers actually use.

children.label: Accent & Pronunciation
children.definition: Pronunciation coaching, accent comparisons, and accent challenges.

sectors.label: Lifestyle
sectors.definition: Personal identity content: routines, fashion, food, home, beauty. Often vlog-style or advice-driven.

children.label: Fitness
children.definition: Exercise for general health, strength, and appearance: workouts, programs, and form for non-competitive training. Training to compete in a sport belongs in Sports > Sports Training.
children.scope_note: Non-competitive exercise. Excludes training to compete in a sport (11.34) and nutrition, sleep, and recovery (09.26).

children.label: Yoga
children.definition: Guided practices or routines designed to improve flexibility, balance, or breath control.

children.label: Beginner Yoga
children.definition: Covers introductory yoga movements, breathing, and alignment for new practitioners.

children.label: Advanced Yoga
children.definition: Covers advanced yoga sequences, inversions, arm balances, and strength-based flexibility work.

children.label: Strength Training
children.definition: Training routines designed to increase muscular strength, endurance, and performance.

children.label: Weightlifting
children.definition: Demonstrates proper form and techniques in free weights and gym-based strength routines.

children.label: Bodyweight Exercises
children.definition: Shows no-equipment exercises emphasizing core strength, mobility, and repetition sets.

children.label: Strength Programs
children.definition: Structured multi-week strength programs built on progressive overload, as opposed to single-lift form and technique.

children.label: Cardio & Conditioning
children.definition: Cardio, HIIT, and follow-along workouts for endurance and general fitness.

children.label: Endurance Cardio
children.definition: Covers running, cycling, rowing, and other aerobic training for endurance and heart health.

children.label: Home HIIT & Conditioning
children.definition: Covers high-intensity and conditioning workouts done at home with little or no equipment.

children.label: Food & Cooking
children.definition: Content showcasing food prep, recipes, taste tests, cooking tips, and culinary storytelling.

children.label: Dishes & Meals
children.definition: What people cook: specific dishes, cuisines, diets, and meal types.
children.scope_note: Excludes diet plans built around health goals (09.26.052) and allergen-free cooking (09.49.092).

children.label: Vegan Dishes
children.definition: Prepares plant-based meals using accessible ingredients and clean presentation.

children.label: Quick Meals
children.definition: Demonstrates meals that can be prepared in 30 minutes or less for time-conscious audiences.

children.label: Cooking Techniques
children.definition: Techniques, methods, or principles used to prepare food or refine cooking skills.

children.label: Baking
children.definition: Covers baking techniques including dough preparation, timing, decoration, and ingredient handling.

children.label: Grilling & BBQ
children.definition: Offers instruction or techniques for grilling meat, vegetables, or specialty items over open flame or heat.

children.label: Grocery Shopping
children.definition: Walks through shopping routines, product selection, or budgeting in grocery settings.

children.label: Household Essentials
children.definition: Covers shopping for cleaning products, paper goods, and other non-food household staples on grocery runs.

children.label: Taste Tests
children.definition: Trying, ranking, and reacting to foods, menus, and products, usually on camera and often against each other.
children.scope_note: Excludes restaurant and food travel guides (14.42.086).

children.label: Fast Food
children.definition: Covers fast-food chains and their menus, including oversized, secret, and novelty items.

children.label: Restaurants & Packaged Foods
children.definition: Covers restaurants, menu items, and packaged grocery foods tried and judged on taste.

children.label: Drinks & Cocktails
children.definition: Cocktails, wine, beer, spirits, coffee, and other drinks: recipes, tasting, and culture.
children.scope_note: Alcohol content adds 17.56.125 to sensitive_topics. Non-alcoholic drinks need no flag.

children.label: Cocktails & Mixed Drinks
children.definition: Covers cocktails, mocktails, coffee drinks, and other prepared beverages.

children.label: Wine, Beer & Spirits
children.definition: Covers wine, beer, and spirits, including styles, regions, and producers.

children.label: Fashion & Beauty
children.definition: Aesthetic-focused content including makeup tutorials, hauls, styling, skincare, and reviews.

children.label: Makeup
children.definition: Makeup application, techniques, products, and transformations.
children.scope_note: Excludes skincare (03.09.134) and cosmetic procedures (09.49.100).

children.label: Everyday Makeup
children.definition: Covers natural, everyday makeup looks for work, school, and daily wear.

children.label: SFX & Fantasy Makeup
children.definition: Covers dramatic, fantasy, and special effects makeup using prosthetics, body paint, and FX products.

children.label: Fashion Trends
children.definition: Content about seasonal, cultural, or community trends in personal style or appearance.

children.label: Streetwear
children.definition: Covers urban fashion trends rooted in youth culture, sneakers, skatewear, or music scenes.

children.label: High Fashion
children.definition: Showcases couture, editorial, and designer fashion with a focus on artistic presentation and runway aesthetics.

children.label: Skincare
children.definition: Skin health and appearance: routines, products, ingredients, and treatments for specific concerns.
children.scope_note: Excludes clinical treatments such as Botox or filler (09.49.100) and makeup (03.09.017).

children.label: Skin Types & Regimens
children.definition: Covers building morning and night skincare regimens for different skin types.

children.label: Skincare Products & Dupes
children.definition: Covers skincare products and brands, including cheaper alternatives to popular items.

children.label: Ingredient Science
children.definition: What active ingredients do, how to combine them, and what the evidence says.

example_concepts.concept: What Studies Say On Vitamin C

children.label: Skin Concerns
children.definition: Acne, aging, hyperpigmentation, and other concerns, including treatment journeys.

children.label: Home & Garden
children.definition: Functional or aesthetic content about living spaces — cleaning, decor, plants, repairs.

children.label: Beekeeping
children.definition: Teaches beekeeping basics, hive care, and honey harvesting techniques.

children.label: Hive Management
children.definition: Demonstrates beekeeping techniques including hive health, harvesting, and safety.

children.label: Home Renovation
children.definition: Guides home improvement, interior updates, or repair and renovation tutorials.
children.scope_note: Renovating a home to live in. Excludes flipping homes for profit (08.62.148).

children.label: Room Renovations
children.definition: Covers do-it-yourself renovation of individual rooms such as kitchens, bathrooms, and bedrooms.

children.label: Household Appliances
children.definition: Appliances and gadgets for running a home, such as vacuums, air fryers, and cleaning tools, judged on daily household use. Connected and smart-home tech belongs in Consumer Tech > Smart Devices.
children.scope_note: Excludes connected and smart-home devices (04.10.020).

children.label: Kitchen & Cleaning Appliances
children.definition: Covers kitchen and cleaning appliances such as air fryers, blenders, vacuums, and mops, judged on daily use.

children.label: Personal Celebrations
children.definition: Content that shares or stages milestone moments like weddings, birthdays, or reveals.
children.scope_note: Excludes dating and relationship advice (03.61).

children.label: Weddings & Milestones
children.definition: Planning, staging, and sharing weddings, birthdays, reveals, and other milestone events.

children.label: Marriage Ceremonies
children.definition: Shares wedding rituals, planning, cultural variations, or personal love stories.

children.label: Hobbies & Collecting
children.definition: Hobby practice and collecting: sourcing, grading, displaying, and trading collectibles.

children.label: Comic Book Collecting
children.definition: Discusses how to collect, grade, or organize comic books and related memorabilia.
children.scope_note: Comics as objects to collect, grade, and trade. Excludes comic stories and characters (06.48.099).

children.label: Comic Grading & Valuation
children.definition: Covers grading, preserving, and valuing comic books and related merchandise.

children.label: Cannabis Culture
children.definition: Recreational cannabis products, culture, and home growing where legal.
children.scope_note: Adds 17.56.125 to sensitive_topics.

children.label: Cannabis Products
children.definition: Covers cannabis strains, edibles, and consumption devices.

children.label: Home Growing
children.definition: Growing cannabis at home where legal, from setup to harvest.

children.label: Relationships & Dating
children.definition: Dating, relationships, and singlehood, from advice and stories to couples content.
children.scope_note: Excludes weddings and milestone events (03.50) and family life (10.29.059).

children.label: Dating
children.definition: Meeting people and early-stage dating, including apps, first dates, and dating culture.

children.label: Flirting & Attraction
children.definition: Covers meeting people, flirting, texting, and reading romantic signals.

children.label: Personal Dating Life
children.definition: Covers creators' own dating lives, including first dates, mishaps, and ongoing updates.

children.label: Dating App Culture
children.definition: Dating apps, profiles, and the culture around online dating.

children.label: Relationships & Couples
children.definition: Committed relationships, from couples content to advice on making them work.

children.label: Couple Life
children.definition: Covers couples' everyday life together, including shared routines, milestones, and relationship dynamics.

children.label: Relationship Health
children.definition: Covers communication, conflict resolution, and keeping long-term relationships healthy.

children.label: Breakups & Singlehood
children.definition: Ending relationships, recovering from them, and being single.

children.label: Breakup Recovery
children.definition: Getting over a breakup, including personal stories and advice.

sectors.label: Technology
sectors.definition: Covers tools, software, hardware, AI, reviews, product demos. Can be consumer or technical in scope.

children.label: Consumer Tech
children.definition: Reviews and usage of personal tech products like phones, gadgets, and wearables.

children.label: Personal Gadgets
children.definition: Personal tech products such as phones, laptops, headphones, and wearables.

children.label: Smartphones
children.definition: Reviews or compares phone models, features, or accessories with a focus on consumer usability.

children.label: Wearables
children.definition: Explores fitness trackers, smartwatches, and AR devices through demonstrations or performance tests.

children.label: Smart Devices
children.definition: Connected and smart-enabled devices, including smart-home hubs, automation, and IoT gadgets: setup, ecosystems, and how the technology works.
children.scope_note: Excludes non-connected household appliances (03.47.103).

children.label: Home Automation
children.definition: Demonstrates or reviews smart home systems like lighting, thermostats, or voice-controlled hubs.

children.label: IoT Gadgets
children.definition: Explains interconnected smart devices and their functionality in home, work, or lifestyle applications.

children.label: Software & Coding
children.definition: Instructional or exploratory content focused on programming, debugging, and digital tools.
children.scope_note: Content about software and code for practitioners. Excludes beginner coding lessons (02.05.009).

children.label: App Development
children.definition: Demonstrations or walkthroughs of building or deploying software applications.

children.label: iOS & Android Development
children.definition: Covers building and deploying native and cross-platform apps for iOS and Android.

children.label: Desktop App Development
children.definition: Covers building and deploying desktop applications for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

children.label: Programming Skills
children.definition: Conceptual or instructional content on writing, structuring, or improving code logic.

children.label: Code Debugging
children.definition: Walks through identifying and fixing errors in software, often using real-time screen capture or examples.

children.label: Clean Code & Conventions
children.definition: Covers professional coding habits, conventions, and code quality practices.

children.label: Digital Culture
children.definition: Content that documents, reflects, or participates in platform-native trends, memes, or subcultures.

children.label: Internet Trends
children.definition: Highlights or commentary on current viral moments, internet behavior, and digital culture.

children.label: Social Media Shifts
children.definition: Analyzes updates, platform policy changes, or user behavior trends shaping social ecosystems.

children.label: Meme Culture
children.definition: Explores viral formats, remix behavior, or visual language emerging from internet humor.

children.label: Digital Media
children.definition: Analysis or documentation of how digital platforms shape culture and interaction.

children.label: Video Creation
children.definition: Creating, structuring, and growing video-first content across platforms.

children.label: Podcasting
children.definition: Hosting, editing, growing, and monetizing a podcast.

children.label: Emerging Tech
children.definition: Content featuring experimental or high-growth technologies like AI, blockchain, and VR/AR.

children.label: AI Applications
children.definition: Demonstrations or explanations of how AI models or tools are used in real scenarios.

children.label: Chatbots
children.definition: Demonstrates how chatbots are built, trained, and used in customer service, content, or automation workflows.

example_concepts.concept: Can a Chatbot Run My Inbox

children.label: Machine Learning
children.definition: Explains how ML models are structured, trained, and applied across tasks like prediction, classification, or personalization.

children.label: AI Tools & Productivity
children.definition: Demos and reviews of consumer AI tools for work, study, and creative tasks.

children.label: Blockchain Tech
children.definition: Explains blockchain technology, decentralization, crypto, or smart contracts.
children.scope_note: How blockchains and smart contracts work. Excludes trading and crypto markets (08.22.045).

children.label: Crypto Protocols & Technology
children.definition: Breaks down how digital currencies function, how to trade them, and the risks or innovations they bring.

children.label: Smart Contracts
children.definition: Explains how blockchain-based contracts execute automatically, often using real-world examples or project walkthroughs.

sectors.label: News & Commentary
sectors.definition: Discusses current events, politics, cultural takes. Includes both factual updates and subjective analysis.

children.label: Current Events
children.definition: Real-time or recent commentary on news, culture, or global developments.

children.label: Breaking News
children.definition: Real-time or same-day coverage of breaking stories, emergencies, or global events.
children.scope_note: Excludes ongoing war coverage (05.15.104). Tragedies involving real victims add 17.52.123 to sensitive_topics.

children.label: Developing Stories
children.definition: Stories still unfolding, such as emergencies, disasters, or fast-moving events, with information changing as it comes in.

children.label: Aftermath & Follow-Ups
children.definition: Coverage after a news event has broken: outcomes, reactions, and follow-up reporting.

children.label: General News
children.definition: Headlines and stories across topics, at national, local, or regional level.

children.label: Top Headlines
children.definition: The day's most important stories across topics.

children.label: Local & Regional News
children.definition: News from a specific city, state, or region.

children.label: Politics & Opinion
children.definition: Political ideas, takes, or debates — includes ideology breakdowns, campaigns, and critiques.

children.label: Political Discourse
children.definition: Contested political and social questions and the argument around them.

children.label: Current Politics
children.definition: Covers day-to-day political news, figures, and party developments as they unfold.

children.label: Contested Issues
children.definition: Controversial political and social issues where viewpoints sharply divide.

children.label: Policy Analysis
children.definition: Breakdowns or analysis of political issues, proposals, or legislative actions.

children.label: Legislation & Bills
children.definition: Breaks down bills, laws, or political decisions with context, critique, or explainer framing.

children.label: Elections & Campaigns
children.definition: Covers candidates, campaigns, polling, and voter behavior before and after elections.

children.label: Conspiracy Theories
children.definition: Explores secretive narratives, alternate histories, or fringe theories critically or speculatively.
children.scope_note: Excludes ghosts and unexplained phenomena (13.39.080).

children.label: Government Secrets
children.definition: Explores declassified documents, covert programs, or conspiracy-related theories.

children.label: Event Mysteries
children.definition: Investigates unexplained public events or phenomena through timelines and theories.

children.label: War and Conflicts
children.definition: Analyzes or recounts war history, military conflicts, or international relations.

children.label: Geopolitics & International Relations
children.definition: Covers the alliances, rivalries, territorial disputes, and diplomacy behind current and recent conflicts.

example_concepts.concept: Origins of the Conflict Deep Dive

children.label: Military History
children.definition: Narrative and analytical history of past wars, battles, and military strategy.

children.label: Active Conflicts
children.definition: Ongoing coverage of developments in an active conflict.

children.label: Veterans & Civilians in War
children.definition: Covers the lives and experiences of veterans, service members, and civilians affected by conflict.

children.label: Culture & Society
children.definition: Observations on identity, values, behavior, rituals, or subcultures within society.

children.label: Social Issues
children.definition: Content that explores social justice issues, equity, and systemic critique.
children.scope_note: Commentary and analysis of social issues. Excludes advocacy and calls to action (10.30).

children.label: Criminal Justice & Civil Rights
children.definition: Covers law, policing, incarceration, civil rights, and systemic inequality.

children.label: Underrepresented Communities
children.definition: Covers the lived experiences and concerns of underrepresented and marginalized communities.

children.label: Cultural Trends
children.definition: Describes cultural behaviors, rituals, changes, or subgroups within society.

children.label: Fashion Shifts
children.definition: Analyzes changes in fashion trends over time, across regions, or within subcultures.

children.label: Technology & Society
children.definition: Covers how emerging technologies affect behavior, work, ethics, and cultural norms.

example_concepts.concept: Is Social Tech Net Positive Debate

children.label: Crime Narratives
children.definition: True crime-style storytelling focused on criminal events, investigations, or justice.
children.scope_note: Crimes involving real victims add 17.52.123 to sensitive_topics.

children.label: Solved Cases & Trials
children.definition: Covers specific criminal cases that have been solved or prosecuted, from the crime through trial and verdict.

children.label: Unsolved & Cold Cases
children.definition: Covers unsolved crimes, cold cases, and missing-person cases with open questions.

sectors.label: Creative Arts
sectors.definition: Expression-first content: music, performance, drawing, animation, poetry, design. Often overlaps with entertainment but prioritizes craft.

children.label: Visual Arts
children.definition: Content based on visual creative process — including drawing, illustration, or digital design.

children.label: Drawing
children.definition: Instruction or process documentation of analog or digital drawing techniques.

children.label: Sketching Techniques
children.definition: Teaches foundational linework, shading, and drawing fundamentals through process demos.

children.label: Illustration Styles
children.definition: Compares or teaches stylistic approaches to digital or analog illustration.

children.label: Digital Art
children.definition: Creation-focused digital art content using illustration software or design tools.

children.label: Graphic Design
children.definition: Covers composition, layout, typography, and branding in design tools and platforms.

children.label: 3D Modeling
children.definition: Demonstrates how to create or manipulate three-dimensional objects in virtual space using software.

children.label: Music Creation
children.definition: Behind-the-scenes or tutorial-based content showing how music is written, recorded, or produced.

children.label: Songwriting
children.definition: Shows the process of writing lyrics, melody, or full compositions for music.

children.label: Lyric Writing
children.definition: Shows how lyrics are structured, drafted, or rewritten in different musical genres.

children.label: Melody Crafting
children.definition: Breaks down how melodies are developed using voice, instrument, or digital tools.

children.label: Music Production
